script:
"""
ClefinCode Chat - Setup Script
================================
يقوم هذا السكريبت بإعداد جميع إعدادات ClefinCode Chat تلقائياً
WhatsApp + Facebook Messenger + Instagram

طريقة التشغيل:
  cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench
  bench --site site1.local execute clefincode_setup.setup_all

أو من سطر الأوامر مباشرة:
  bench --site site1.local console
  ثم: exec(open('/path/to/clefincode_setup.py').read())
"""

import frappe

# ============================================================
# ⚙️  عدّل هذه القيم فقط
# ============================================================

CONFIG = {
    # --- معلومات الموقع ---
    "site_url": "https://YOUR_PUBLIC_DOMAIN.com",   # ← ضع دومين حقيقي، ليس localhost

    # --- WhatsApp (Meta Business API) ---
    "whatsapp": {
        "enabled": True,
        "whatsapp_number": "218XXXXXXXXX",           # رقم واتساب بدون + أو 00
        "phone_number_id": "PHONE_NUMBER_ID",        # من Meta Developer
        "business_account_id": "WABA_ID",            # WhatsApp Business Account ID
        "access_token": "YOUR_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN",
        "verify_token": "Syncmta2026",               # نفس الموجود في Meta Webhook
        "type": "Support",                           # Personal أو Support
        "user": "alhraryant@gravity.com",            # المستخدم الذي يستقبل الرسائل
    },

    # --- Facebook Messenger ---
    "messenger": {
        "enabled": True,
        "page_access_token": "YOUR_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN",
        "messenger_profile_id": "2026",              # Facebook Page ID (موجود في صورتك)
        "verify_token": "Syncmta2026",
        "type": "Support",
        "user": "alhraryant@gravity.com",
    },

    # --- Instagram ---
    "instagram": {
        "enabled": True,
        "access_token": "YOUR_INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN",  # نفس Page Access Token
        "instagram_profile_id": "INSTAGRAM_ID",
        "username": "YOUR_INSTAGRAM_USERNAME",
        "verify_token": "Syncmta2026",
        "type": "Support",
        "user": "alhraryant@gravity.com",
    },

    # --- المستخدمون المصرح لهم ---
    "authorized_users": [
        "Administrator",
        "alhraryant@gravity.com",
        "test1@ggg.com",
    ],
}

# ============================================================
# لا تعدل ما تحت هذا السطر
# ============================================================

def log(msg):
    print(f"  ✓ {msg}")

def warn(msg):
    print(f"  ⚠️  {msg}")


def setup_chat_settings():
    """إعداد ClefinCode Chat Settings الأساسية"""
    print("\n[1/4] إعداد Chat Settings...")
    
    try:
        settings = frappe.get_single("ClefinCode Chat Settings")
        settings.enable_mobile_notifications = 1
        settings.with_message_content = 1
        settings.enable_portal_support = 1
        settings.role = "All"
        settings.chat_support_title = "Chat"
        settings.welcome_message = "مرحباً، كيف يمكننا مساعدتك؟"
        settings.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        log("تم حفظ Chat Settings")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"Chat Settings: {e}")


def setup_whatsapp():
    """إعداد WhatsApp Profile"""
    cfg = CONFIG["whatsapp"]
    if not cfg["enabled"]:
        return
    
    print("\n[2/4] إعداد WhatsApp Profile...")
    
    # إنشاء WhatsApp Integration
    try:
        if not frappe.db.exists("ClefinCode WhatsApp Integration", cfg["whatsapp_number"]):
            integration = frappe.new_doc("ClefinCode WhatsApp Integration")
            integration.whatsapp_number = cfg["whatsapp_number"]
            integration.access_token = cfg["access_token"]
            integration.verify_token = cfg["verify_token"]
            integration.phone_number_id = cfg["phone_number_id"]
            integration.business_account_id = cfg["business_account_id"]
            integration.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            log(f"تم إنشاء WhatsApp Integration: {cfg['whatsapp_number']}")
        else:
            log("WhatsApp Integration موجود مسبقاً")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"WhatsApp Integration: {e}")

    # إنشاء WhatsApp Profile
    try:
        profile_name = f"WA-{cfg['whatsapp_number']}"
        if not frappe.db.exists("ClefinCode WhatsApp Profile", profile_name):
            profile = frappe.new_doc("ClefinCode WhatsApp Profile")
            profile.whatsapp_number = cfg["whatsapp_number"]
            profile.phone_number_id = cfg["phone_number_id"]
            profile.business_account_id = cfg["business_account_id"]
            profile.type = cfg["type"]
            profile.provider = "Meta"
            profile.user = cfg["user"]
            profile.meta_template_name = "confirm_message_template"
            profile.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            log(f"تم إنشاء WhatsApp Profile: {profile_name}")
        else:
            log("WhatsApp Profile موجود مسبقاً")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"WhatsApp Profile: {e}")


def setup_messenger():
    """إعداد Facebook Messenger"""
    cfg = CONFIG["messenger"]
    if not cfg["enabled"]:
        return
    
    print("\n[3/4] إعداد Facebook Messenger...")

    # إنشاء Messenger Integration
    try:
        if not frappe.db.exists("ClefinCode Facebook Messenger Integration", {"page_access_token": cfg["page_access_token"]}):
            integration = frappe.new_doc("ClefinCode Facebook Messenger Integration")
            integration.page_access_token = cfg["page_access_token"]
            integration.verify_token = cfg["verify_token"]
            integration.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            log("تم إنشاء Messenger Integration")
        else:
            log("Messenger Integration موجود مسبقاً")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"Messenger Integration: {e}")

    # إنشاء Messenger Profile (مثل ما في صورتك: chat massenger)
    try:
        if not frappe.db.exists("ClefinCode Facebook Messenger Profile", "chat massenger"):
            profile = frappe.new_doc("ClefinCode Facebook Messenger Profile")
            profile.name = "chat massenger"
            profile.type = cfg["type"]
            profile.messenger_profile_id = cfg["messenger_profile_id"]
            profile.role = "All"
            
            # إضافة المستخدمين المصرح لهم
            for user_email in CONFIG["authorized_users"]:
                if frappe.db.exists("User", user_email):
                    profile.append("authorized_users", {"user": user_email})
            
            profile.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            log(f"تم إنشاء Messenger Profile (ID: {cfg['messenger_profile_id']})")
        else:
            # تحديث التوكن فقط
            log("Messenger Profile موجود مسبقاً")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"Messenger Profile: {e}")


def setup_instagram():
    """إعداد Instagram"""
    cfg = CONFIG["instagram"]
    if not cfg["enabled"]:
        return
    
    print("\n[4/4] إعداد Instagram...")

    # إنشاء Instagram Integration
    try:
        if not frappe.db.exists("ClefinCode Instagram Integration", {"access_token": cfg["access_token"]}):
            integration = frappe.new_doc("ClefinCode Instagram Integration")
            integration.access_token = cfg["access_token"]
            integration.verify_token = cfg["verify_token"]
            integration.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            log("تم إنشاء Instagram Integration")
        else:
            log("Instagram Integration موجود مسبقاً")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"Instagram Integration: {e}")

    # إنشاء Instagram Profile
    try:
        profile_name = f"IG-{cfg['username']}"
        if not frappe.db.exists("ClefinCode Instagram Profile", profile_name):
            profile = frappe.new_doc("ClefinCode Instagram Profile")
            profile.instagram_profile_id = cfg["instagram_profile_id"]
            profile.username = cfg["username"]
            profile.type = cfg["type"]
            profile.user = cfg["user"]
            profile.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            log(f"تم إنشاء Instagram Profile: @{cfg['username']}")
        else:
            log("Instagram Profile موجود مسبقاً")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"Instagram Profile: {e}")


def print_webhook_info():
    """طباعة معلومات Webhook للنسخ في Meta Developer"""
    site_url = CONFIG["site_url"]
    verify_token = CONFIG["whatsapp"]["verify_token"]
    
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("📋 معلومات Webhook - انسخها في Meta Developer")
    print("="*60)
    print(f"\n🔗 Callback URL:")
    print(f"   {site_url}/api/method/clefincode_chat.api.webhook.handle")
    print(f"\n🔑 Verify Token:")
    print(f"   {verify_token}")
    print(f"\n📌 اشترك في هذه الأحداث (Subscribed Fields):")
    print(f"   WhatsApp   → messages")
    print(f"   Messenger  → messages, messaging_postbacks")
    print(f"   Instagram  → messages")
    print("\n⚠️  تذكر:")
    print("   - يجب أن يكون الدومين HTTPS وليس localhost")
    print("   - إذا كنت تعمل محلياً استخدم ngrok:")
    print("     ngrok http 8000")
    print("="*60)


def check_missing_tokens():
    """تحقق من التوكنات المفقودة"""
    print("\n🔍 فحص الإعدادات...")
    issues = []
    
    if "YOUR_" in CONFIG["whatsapp"]["access_token"]:
        issues.append("❌ WhatsApp Access Token غير محدد")
    if "YOUR_" in CONFIG["whatsapp"]["phone_number_id"]:
        issues.append("❌ Phone Number ID غير محدد")
    if "YOUR_" in CONFIG["messenger"]["page_access_token"]:
        issues.append("❌ Facebook Page Access Token غير محدد")
    if "YOUR_" in CONFIG["instagram"]["access_token"]:
        issues.append("❌ Instagram Access Token غير محدد")
    if "YOUR_PUBLIC_DOMAIN" in CONFIG["site_url"]:
        issues.append("❌ Site URL غير محدد (localhost لا يعمل مع Meta)")
    
    if issues:
        print("\n⚠️  يجب تعديل هذه القيم في قسم CONFIG أعلى السكريبت:")
        for issue in issues:
            print(f"   {issue}")
        print("\n   بعد التعديل شغّل السكريبت مرة أخرى")
        return False
    return True


def setup_all():
    """الدالة الرئيسية - تشغيل كل الإعدادات"""
    print("\n🚀 ClefinCode Chat - بدء الإعداد التلقائي")
    print("="*60)
    
    if not check_missing_tokens():
        return
    
    frappe.flags.ignore_mandatory = True
    
    setup_chat_settings()
    setup_whatsapp()
    setup_messenger()
    setup_instagram()
    
    frappe.db.commit()
    
    print_webhook_info()
    
    print("\n✅ تم الإعداد بنجاح!")
    print("   افتح ERPNext وتحقق من:")
    print("   - ClefinCode Chat Settings")
    print("   - ClefinCode WhatsApp Profile")
    print("   - ClefinCode Facebook Messenger Profile")
    print("   - ClefinCode Instagram Profile\n")


# تشغيل مباشر إذا نُفِّذ من console
if __name__ == "__main__":
    setup_all()
else:
    # عند التشغيل عبر bench execute
    setup_all()
